diff --git a/src/spreadsheet_harness/financial_model_repairs.py b/src/spreadsheet_harness/financial_model_repairs.py
--- a/src/spreadsheet_harness/financial_model_repairs.py
+++ b/src/spreadsheet_harness/financial_model_repairs.py
@@ -5383,3 +5383,423 @@
     "translate_repeated_financial_period_formulas",
     "restore_incomplete_financial_formula_bands",
 ]
+
+_FIN15K_CANDIDATE_SIZE = 200
+
+# Fin15k development-evidence candidate: conservative mechanical continuation.
+from collections import Counter as _CandidateCounter
+from openpyxl.formula.tokenizer import Tokenizer as _CandidateTokenizer
+
+
+def _candidate_label_signature(value: Any) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Keep category letters, percentages, ordinals and economic qualifiers."""
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or value.startswith("="):
+        return ()
+    text = value.casefold().replace("%", " percent ").replace("&", " and ")
+    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text)
+    while words and words[0] == "the":
+        words.pop(0)
+    while words and words[-1] in {"line", "row", "column", "cell"}:
+        words.pop()
+    aliases = {"assets": "asset", "liabilities": "liability", "revenues": "revenue",
+               "expenses": "expense", "totals": "total", "shares": "share",
+               "percentages": "percent", "percentage": "percent"}
+    return tuple(aliases.get(word, word) for word in words if word not in {"and", "of"})
+
+
+def _candidate_sheet_signature(value: Any) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    text = str(value or "").strip().strip("\"'")
+    text = re.sub(r"\s+(?:sheet|tab|worksheet)$", "", text, flags=re.I)
+    return tuple(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.casefold()))
+
+
+def _find_sheet(workbook: Any, hint: str) -> Any | None:
+    """Exact catalogue match first; a partial sheet hint must be unique."""
+    wanted = _candidate_sheet_signature(hint)
+    if not wanted:
+        return None
+    exact = [ws for ws in workbook.worksheets
+             if _candidate_sheet_signature(ws.title) == wanted]
+    if exact:
+        return exact[0] if len(exact) == 1 else None
+    partial = [ws for ws in workbook.worksheets
+               if set(wanted).issubset(_candidate_sheet_signature(ws.title))]
+    return partial[0] if len(partial) == 1 else None
+
+
+def _candidate_resolved_label(worksheet: Any, value: Any,
+                              seen: frozenset[tuple[str, str]] = frozenset()) -> Any:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.startswith("="):
+        return value
+    linked = re.fullmatch(
+        r"=\+?(?:'(?P<quoted>(?:[^']|'')+)'|(?P<plain>[^'!]+))!"
+        r"\$?(?P<column>[A-Z]{1,3})\$?(?P<row>\d+)", value.strip(), re.I)
+    workbook = getattr(worksheet, "parent", None)
+    if linked is None or workbook is None or len(seen) >= 6:
+        return value
+    name = (linked.group("quoted") or linked.group("plain")).replace("''", "'").strip()
+    coordinate = f"{linked.group('column')}{linked.group('row')}"
+    key = (name, coordinate)
+    if name not in workbook.sheetnames or key in seen:
+        return value
+    return _candidate_resolved_label(workbook[name], workbook[name][coordinate].value,
+                                     seen | {key})
+
+
+def _find_row_by_label(worksheet: Any, hint: str) -> int | None:
+    """No first-row/tiny-token tie breaker: repeated labels need human context."""
+    wanted = _candidate_label_signature(hint)
+    if not wanted:
+        return None
+    max_row, max_column = _content_bounds(worksheet)
+    matches: set[int] = set()
+    for row in range(1, max_row + 1):
+        for column in range(1, min(max_column, 8) + 1):
+            value = _candidate_resolved_label(worksheet, worksheet.cell(row, column).value)
+            if _candidate_label_signature(value) == wanted:
+                matches.add(row)
+    return next(iter(matches)) if len(matches) == 1 else None
+
+
+def _instruction_formula_row(worksheet: Any, hint: str) -> int | None:
+    return _find_row_by_label(worksheet, hint)
+
+
+def _find_instruction_target_row(worksheet: Any, hint: str) -> int | None:
+    return _find_row_by_label(worksheet, hint)
+
+
+def _candidate_reference_cells(worksheet: Any, reference: str) -> list[Any] | None:
+    """Resolve only bounded workbook-local A1 ranges; never guess named refs."""
+    match = re.fullmatch(
+        r"(?:(?:'(?P<quoted>(?:[^']|'')+)'|(?P<plain>[^'!\[\]]+))!)?"
+        r"(?P<range>\$?[A-Z]{1,3}\$?\d+(?::\$?[A-Z]{1,3}\$?\d+)?)",
+        reference, re.I)
+    if match is None:
+        return None
+    name = match.group("quoted") or match.group("plain")
+    sheet = worksheet
+    if name is not None:
+        name = name.replace("''", "'").strip()
+        workbook = getattr(worksheet, "parent", None)
+        if workbook is None or name not in workbook.sheetnames:
+            return None
+        sheet = workbook[name]
+    try:
+        left, top, right, bottom = range_boundaries(match.group("range").replace("$", ""))
+    except (ValueError, TypeError):
+        return None
+    if left < 1 or top < 1 or right > 16384 or bottom > 1048576:
+        return None
+    if (right - left + 1) * (bottom - top + 1) > 2048:
+        return None
+    # Reading must not materialize the styled worksheet extent or missing cells.
+    cells = getattr(sheet, "_cells", {})
+    return [cells.get((row, column)) for row in range(top, bottom + 1)
+            for column in range(left, right + 1)]
+
+
+def _candidate_static_scalar(worksheet: Any, token: Any) -> float | None:
+    if token.type == "OPERAND" and token.subtype == "NUMBER":
+        try:
+            return float(token.value)
+        except (ValueError, TypeError):
+            return None
+    if token.type == "OPERAND" and token.subtype == "RANGE":
+        cells = _candidate_reference_cells(worksheet, token.value)
+        if cells is None or len(cells) != 1:
+            return None
+        value = getattr(cells[0], "value", None)
+        if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
+            return float(value)
+    return None
+
+
+def _candidate_formula_supported(worksheet: Any, formula: str, target: Any) -> bool:
+    """Static support is deliberately narrower than Excel formula validity."""
+    if not isinstance(formula, str) or not formula.startswith("="):
+        return False
+    if re.search(r"\b(?:INDIRECT|OFFSET)\s*\(|#REF!|\[", formula, re.I):
+        return False
+    try:
+        tokens = [item for item in _CandidateTokenizer(formula).items
+                  if item.type != "WHITE-SPACE"]
+    except Exception:
+        return False
+    reference_count = 0
+    for index, token in enumerate(tokens):
+        if token.type == "OPERAND" and token.subtype == "RANGE":
+            cells = _candidate_reference_cells(worksheet, token.value)
+            if cells is None or not cells:
+                return False
+            values = [getattr(cell, "value", None) for cell in cells]
+            if not any(value is not None for value in values):
+                return False
+            if any(isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("#") for value in values):
+                return False
+            # A scalar dependency must exist. SUM ranges may contain ordinary blanks.
+            if len(values) == 1 and values[0] is None:
+                return False
+            if any(cell is target for cell in cells):
+                return False
+            if token.subtype == "RANGE" and ":" not in token.value:
+                # Uncached formulas may themselves be broken, circular or
+                # undefined. A mechanical continuation is only supported by a
+                # literal driver; formula chains require actual runtime review.
+                value = values[0]
+                if ((isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("="))
+                        or getattr(cells[0], "data_type", None) == "f"):
+                    return False
+            reference_count += 1
+            if _FIN15K_CANDIDATE_SIZE == 500 and "!" in token.value:
+                if not _candidate_cross_period_reference_supported(worksheet, target, token.value):
+                    return False
+        if token.type == "OPERATOR-INFIX" and token.value == "/":
+            # A computed or formula-backed divisor cannot be proved from uncached
+            # source data. Leave it to the model/runtime verifier rather than fill.
+            if index + 1 >= len(tokens):
+                return False
+            divisor = _candidate_static_scalar(worksheet, tokens[index + 1])
+            if divisor is None or not __import__("math").isfinite(divisor) or divisor == 0:
+                return False
+            if index + 2 < len(tokens) and tokens[index + 2].value in {"^", "*", "/", "+", "-"}:
+                return False
+    return reference_count > 0
+
+
+def _candidate_terminal_column(worksheet: Any, column: int) -> bool:
+    max_row, _ = _content_bounds(worksheet)
+    return any(isinstance((value := worksheet.cell(row, column).value), str)
+               and not value.startswith("=")
+               and re.search(r"\b(?:terminal(?:\s+year|\s+value)?|continuing\s+value)\b", value, re.I)
+               for row in range(1, min(max_row, 12) + 1))
+
+
+def translate_repeated_financial_period_formulas(
+    path: str | Path, *, source_path: str | Path, minimum_run: int = 3,
+) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Translate a literal-copy run atomically only when all drivers are present."""
+    output = load_workbook(path, data_only=False, keep_vba=Path(path).suffix.casefold() == ".xlsm")
+    source = load_workbook(source_path, data_only=False, keep_vba=Path(source_path).suffix.casefold() == ".xlsm")
+    changes: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    try:
+        for ws in output.worksheets:
+            if ws.title not in source.sheetnames:
+                continue
+            original = source[ws.title]
+            by_row: dict[int, list[Any]] = {}
+            for cell in list(getattr(ws, "_cells", {}).values()):
+                if (not isinstance(cell, MergedCell) and isinstance(cell.value, str)
+                        and cell.value.startswith("=")
+                        and original.cell(cell.row, cell.column).value is None):
+                    by_row.setdefault(cell.row, []).append(cell)
+            for cells in by_row.values():
+                ordered = sorted(cells, key=lambda cell: cell.column)
+                index = 0
+                while index < len(ordered):
+                    end = index + 1
+                    anchor = ordered[index]
+                    while (end < len(ordered)
+                           and ordered[end].column == ordered[end - 1].column + 1
+                           and ordered[end].value == anchor.value
+                           and ordered[end].style_id == anchor.style_id):
+                        end += 1
+                    run = ordered[index:end]
+                    proposals: list[tuple[Any, str]] = []
+                    safe = len(run) >= max(3, minimum_run)
+                    for target in run:
+                        try:
+                            translated = Translator(anchor.value, origin=anchor.coordinate).translate_formula(target.coordinate)
+                        except (TranslatorError, ValueError, TypeError):
+                            safe = False
+                            break
+                        if (_candidate_terminal_column(ws, target.column)
+                                or not _candidate_formula_supported(ws, translated, target)):
+                            safe = False
+                            break
+                        if translated != target.value:
+                            proposals.append((target, translated))
+                    if safe and len(proposals) >= 2:
+                        for target, formula in proposals:
+                            target.value = formula
+                            changes.append({"sheet": ws.title, "target": target.coordinate, "formula": formula})
+                    index = end
+        if changes:
+            output.save(path)
+    finally:
+        source.close()
+        output.close()
+    return changes
+
+
+def restore_incomplete_financial_formula_bands(
+    path: str | Path, *, source_path: str | Path, minimum_neighbors: int = 2,
+) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Two *original* witnesses and live dependencies; never spread a new guess."""
+    if minimum_neighbors != 2:
+        raise ValueError("This mechanical pass supports exactly two original witnesses")
+    output = load_workbook(path, data_only=False, keep_vba=Path(path).suffix.casefold() == ".xlsm")
+    source = load_workbook(source_path, data_only=False, keep_vba=Path(source_path).suffix.casefold() == ".xlsm")
+    changes: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    try:
+        for ws in output.worksheets:
+            if ws.title not in source.sheetnames:
+                continue
+            original = source[ws.title]
+            original_cells = getattr(original, "_cells", {})
+            proposals: list[tuple[Any, str]] = []
+            for left in list(original_cells.values()):
+                if not isinstance(left.value, str) or not left.value.startswith("="):
+                    continue
+                right = original_cells.get((left.row, left.column + 2))
+                if right is None or not isinstance(right.value, str) or not right.value.startswith("="):
+                    continue
+                old_target = original_cells.get((left.row, left.column + 1))
+                if getattr(old_target, "value", None) is not None:
+                    continue
+                target = ws.cell(left.row, left.column + 1)
+                if isinstance(target, MergedCell) or target.value is not None:
+                    continue
+                if not (left.style_id == right.style_id == target.style_id):
+                    continue
+                # Source witnesses must still be identical; a changed anchor is
+                # new model evidence, not a source-certified continuation.
+                if ws[left.coordinate].value != left.value or ws[right.coordinate].value != right.value:
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    first = Translator(left.value, origin=left.coordinate).translate_formula(target.coordinate)
+                    second = Translator(right.value, origin=right.coordinate).translate_formula(target.coordinate)
+                except (TranslatorError, ValueError, TypeError):
+                    continue
+                if (first != second or _candidate_terminal_column(ws, target.column)
+                        or not _candidate_formula_supported(ws, first, target)):
+                    continue
+                proposals.append((target, first))
+            for target, formula in proposals:
+                target.value = formula
+                changes.append({"sheet": ws.title, "target": target.coordinate, "formula": formula})
+        if changes:
+            output.save(path)
+    finally:
+        source.close()
+        output.close()
+    return changes
+
+# Larger development evidence: resolve public clauses and bound continuations.
+def _instruction_sheet_clauses(instruction: str) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
+    """Parse catalogue-resolvable On/In-the/quoted/bare sheet clauses."""
+    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(instruction or "").strip())
+    starts = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)(?:in\s+the|on)\s+", text, re.I))
+    clauses: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    lead = r"(?:the|please|calculate|compute|link|fill|complete|carry|get|make|derive|update|insert|ensure|work)\b"
+    action = r"(?:please\s+)?(?:calculate|compute|link|fill|complete|carry|get|make|derive|update|insert|ensure|work)\b"
+    for index, marker in enumerate(starts):
+        end = starts[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(starts) else len(text)
+        segment = text[marker.end():end].strip(" .;")
+        # A later bare-title clause is its own sheet scope. Never let its
+        # requested metrics leak into the previous On/In-the sheet's body.
+        bare_boundary = re.search(
+            r"[.;]\s+[^,;.]{1,128}?\s+(?:then\s+)?(?:needs?|has\s+to|must|should)\b",
+            segment, re.I)
+        if bare_boundary is not None:
+            segment = segment[:bare_boundary.start()].strip(" .;")
+        if not segment:
+            continue
+        quoted = re.match(r"(?P<q>['\"])(?P<sheet>.+?)(?P=q)\s*(?:sheet|tab|worksheet)?\s*[,;:\-]?\s*(?P<body>.+)", segment, re.I)
+        if quoted is not None:
+            sheet, body = quoted.group("sheet"), quoted.group("body")
+        else:
+            boundary = re.search(r"[,;:]\s*(?=" + lead + r")", segment, re.I)
+            if boundary is not None:
+                sheet, body = segment[:boundary.start()], segment[boundary.end():]
+            else:
+                boundary = re.search(r"\s+(?=" + action + r")", segment, re.I)
+                if boundary is None:
+                    continue
+                sheet, body = segment[:boundary.start()], segment[boundary.end():]
+        sheet = re.sub(r"\s+(?:sheet|tab|worksheet)$", "", sheet.strip(), flags=re.I)
+        body = body.strip(" .;")
+        if sheet and body and len(sheet) <= 128:
+            clauses.append((sheet, body))
+    # Explicit bare titles are still resolved against the real workbook by
+    # _find_sheet. A preamble such as 'The model needs ...' cannot match it.
+    bare = re.compile(r"(?:^|[.;])\s*(?P<sheet>[^,;.]{1,128}?)\s+"
+                      r"(?P<body>(?:then\s+)?(?:needs?|has\s+to|must|should)\b[^;.]*)(?:[.;]|$)", re.I)
+    for match in bare.finditer(text):
+        sheet = match.group("sheet").strip(" \"'")
+        if re.match(r"(?:on|in\s+the)\b", sheet, re.I):
+            continue
+        clauses.append((sheet, match.group("body").strip(" .;")))
+    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(clauses))
+
+
+def _instruction_target_columns(worksheet: Any, period: str) -> list[int]:
+    """An absent header is not evidence that column C means an invented year."""
+    headers = _instruction_year_columns(worksheet)
+    counts = _CandidateCounter(headers.values())
+    headers = {column: year for column, year in headers.items() if counts[year] == 1
+               and not _candidate_terminal_column(worksheet, column)}
+    if period.casefold() == "all years":
+        return sorted(headers)
+    bounds = _period_year_bounds(period)
+    if bounds is None:
+        return []
+    return [column for column, year in sorted(headers.items())
+            if bounds[0] <= year <= bounds[1]]
+
+
+def _continue_financial_metric_formula_runs(
+    output: Any, source: Any, instruction: str,
+) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    """Unique named row, real period axis, original agreeing formula witnesses."""
+    changes: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    requests = _explicit_calculation_requests(instruction)
+    for sheet_hint, label_hint in _instruction_sheet_metric_hints(instruction):
+        if re.search(r"\b(?:terminal|irr|xirr)\b", label_hint, re.I):
+            continue
+        ws = _find_sheet(output, sheet_hint)
+        if ws is None or ws.title not in source.sheetnames:
+            continue
+        row = _find_row_by_label(ws, label_hint)
+        if row is None:
+            continue
+        original = source[ws.title]
+        columns = sorted(_instruction_year_columns(ws))
+        matched_periods = [period for title, label, period, _ in requests
+                           if _candidate_sheet_signature(title) == _candidate_sheet_signature(sheet_hint)
+                           and _candidate_label_signature(label) == _candidate_label_signature(label_hint)]
+        if matched_periods:
+            wanted = {column for period in matched_periods
+                      for column in _instruction_target_columns(ws, period)}
+            columns = [column for column in columns if column in wanted]
+        if len(columns) < 2:
+            continue
+        seeds = [cell for column in columns
+                 if isinstance((cell := original.cell(row, column)).value, str)
+                 and cell.value.startswith("=") and ws[cell.coordinate].value == cell.value
+                 and not _candidate_terminal_column(ws, column)]
+        if len(seeds) < 2:
+            continue
+        for column in columns:
+            target = ws.cell(row, column)
+            if (isinstance(target, MergedCell) or target.value is not None
+                    or original.cell(row, column).value is not None
+                    or _candidate_terminal_column(ws, column)):
+                continue
+            translated: set[str] = set()
+            for seed in seeds:
+                if seed.style_id != target.style_id:
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    translated.add(Translator(seed.value, origin=seed.coordinate).translate_formula(target.coordinate))
+                except (TranslatorError, ValueError, TypeError):
+                    translated.clear()
+                    break
+            if len(translated) != 1:
+                continue
+            formula = next(iter(translated))
+            if not _candidate_formula_supported(ws, formula, target):
+                continue
+            target.value = formula
+            changes.append({"sheet": ws.title, "target": target.coordinate, "formula": formula})
+    return changes

---
name: spreadsheet-financial-model
description: Complete and repair financial-model schedules while preserving historical periods, assumptions, selectors, and model checks.
---

# Financial-model capability

Produce executable edits, not an uncertainty essay. Treat blank cells as candidates rather than
automatically missing formulas, but resolve the row role, historical/forecast boundary, and
governing pattern from period headers, nearby formulas, labels, and dependency direction before
emitting an action. If the available evidence does not identify an exact target and formula, omit
that action and give the executor one small exact range to inspect; never emit placeholders,
duplicate fields, comments inside values, or speculative zero fills.

- Preserve populated historical values, imported actuals, assumption inputs, scenario selectors,
  check rows, and anchor formulas unless the instruction explicitly targets them.
- When the task prompt reports instruction-grounded deterministic warm-start targets, treat those
  populated cells as protected completed work. Verify them with one bounded
  `sheet_harness.view_xlsx(...)` batch, inspect only clauses that remain visibly blank, and do not
  restart workbook-wide discovery or rewrite a completed formula with a merely equivalent variant.
- Fill a forecast blank only when adjacent periods establish the same semantic row and a formula
  translates cleanly across the boundary. Do not extend formulas into spacer, label, notes, terminal,
  or sensitivity-table regions merely because they are blank.
- Keep absolute and mixed references stable, especially selector cells and assumption rows. Confirm
  that a translated forecast formula points to the intended period and scenario.
- Follow the workbook's stated sign convention. Inspect nearby notes and existing periods before
  writing expense, deduction, cash-outflow, debt-repayment, or contra-account formulas; if the
  model represents deductions as negative numbers, preserve that sign through every dependent row.
- Reconcile sign semantics across schedules rather than judging an isolated formula. Revenue growth
  normally compounds as `prior * (1 + growth)`; after-tax debt cost uses `cost * (1 - tax rate)`;
  equity value subtracts net debt from enterprise value; and unlevered free cash flow subtracts both
  capex and an increase in net working capital. Apply these identities only when the row labels and
  the workbook's source schedules establish the same convention.
- For totals, ratios, debt schedules, and roll-forwards, inspect the smallest decisive dependencies
  and check the relevant accounting identity or continuity equation after recalculation.
- Cover every independently requested schedule or chart. Group a horizontal forecast into one
  translatable range action only when its top-left formula has been grounded. A formula for a
  multi-cell target must be the real top-left formula with relative references that translate.
- Prefer copying the workbook's adjacent formula pattern over inventing a textbook identity. Use
  a textbook identity only when row labels and the named source cells establish every operand.
- Reject a bulk proposal that mixes blank targets with populated cells. Escalate populated targets
  to exact executor inspection instead of overwriting them from a plan.

After editing, compare the changed cells and their immediate boundaries against the original,
recalculate, and confirm that existing historical/anchor cells remain unchanged and model checks do
not worsen.

## Financial target identity and typed outputs

Identify the requested financial calculation locally before filling: unique sheet and logical
block, complete metric label, sign convention, output type, and period header. Preserve single
letter/category labels and percent markers: A, A%, a category flag and a numeric ratio are not
interchangeable. A YES/NO flag or category must keep its declared text domain; do not substitute
1/0 just because a formula computes. Respect existing expenses/deductions signs and verify the
same convention in their dependent total. Derive quantities from the workbook, not constants
invented to make a check cell pass.

Blank cells outside that contract remain blank. Repeated captions in a second table are ambiguous
until its header and operands establish that it is requested. Never extend a missing financial
formula merely because another calculation can be mechanically translated into the cell.

Parse every instruction-named sheet and clause, including On/in and quoted names. If sheet or metric names have multiple matches, inspect the smallest decisive block; do not pick the first partial-token match. Check denominator support before adding ratios.
